proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hs hpar hd
  have hBA : B ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
  have m1 : C -ᵥ D ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  have hn : ‖B -ᵥ A‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (vsub_ne_zero.mpr hBA)
  have hk1 : |k| = 1 := by
    rw [dist_comm A B, dist_comm D C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A, dist_eq_norm_vsub V C D, ← hk, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs] at hd
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hn
    rw [one_mul]; exact hd.symm
  rcases (abs_eq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mp hk1 with h | h
  · rw [← hk, h, one_smul]
  · exfalso
    rw [h, neg_one_smul] at hk
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hw⟩ := AffineSubspace.wOppSide_iff_exists_wbtw.mp hs.1
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := hw
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hp
    apply hs.2.1
    have e : D -ᵥ B = C -ᵥ A := by
      have e1 : D -ᵥ B = (D -ᵥ C) + (C -ᵥ A) + (A -ᵥ B) := by
        rw [vsub_add_vsub_cancel, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
      rw [e1, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C D, ← hk, neg_neg, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B A]
      abel
    refine mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr ⟨y - x, ?_⟩
    have h2 := congrArg (· -ᵥ A) hy
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub, vadd_vsub_assoc, e] at h2
    apply vsub_left_cancel (p := A)
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub, sub_smul, h2]
    abel
